notes: Recorded by the player in their live client from an installed source-tree build of this commit (git archive, version stamped v1.8.2-dev+65ac064) linked in place of the store ForeverCore v1.8.2; check_visual_proof --compare reported no missing or differing runtime files, the install additionally carries the ignored store icon media/icon-400.png. The game's own Cooldown Manager was on screen for comparison.

flows.name: CooldownIcon draws the Cooldown Manager frame
steps: Install the candidate in place of ForeverCore v1.8.2 and /reload
/run a 60x60 frame at CENTER with an ARTWORK texture, then ForeverCore.Art.CooldownIcon(t, 134400, 50)
A question-mark icon shows with the Cooldown Manager mask and overlay, matching the edge of the client's own Cooldown Manager icons on the same screen
